reason: I only have Saturdays with my kid and the Salisbury Zoo is free, so paying $14 a visit for a cafe feels like a lot when we already have a go-to. I'd maybe take the free first visit, but I wouldn't spend money on it.
objection: Sounds expensive and a bit Instagram for Salisbury. With weekends only, I'd be paying $14 a time (or $45 a month) for maybe 3 or 4 Saturdays, when the zoo costs nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price closer to $8-10 a visit, or a drop-in that works out cheaper than a trip to the zoo on a rainy or hot Saturday.
